_about: Risk rules for flax 0.12.x. 'unsafe' = disk/network/host-callback; 'safe' = pure computation; 'dual_use' = flagged for a specific capability beyond pure computation, reason stated per entry. Covers the commonly-used flax.linen surface; anything uncatalogued falls through to 'review'. Cross-library rules in _common/default are merged in on top of these. This is advisory, not a proof.

dual_use.flax.linen.Module: Flax module base class; required to define a model. allow_base_class_attributes widens what the verifier treats as valid attribute access — keep it False to require explicit assignment.

safe.flax.linen.Bidirectional: Bidirectional wrapper running a cell forward and backward.
safe.flax.linen.DenseGeneral: Dense layer contracting over arbitrary axes.
safe.flax.linen.Einsum: Einsum layer with a learned operand.
safe.flax.linen.OptimizedLSTMCell: LSTM cell with a fused implementation.
safe.flax.linen.Partitioned: Sharding-metadata wrapper for a parameter; structural annotation.
safe.flax.linen.RNN: Recurrent layer applying a cell over a sequence.
safe.flax.linen.Sequential: Container applying sub-layers in order; the sub-layers are allow-listed separately.
safe.flax.linen.Variable: Handle to a module variable; a state reference, not compute or IO.
safe.flax.linen.checkpoint: Rematerialization transform (alias of remat); not disk checkpointing.
safe.flax.linen.combine_masks: Combines boolean masks with logical AND.
safe.flax.linen.compact: Decorator marking a module's inline-submodule method; structural.
safe.flax.linen.cond: Lifted conditional executing one of two branches.
safe.flax.linen.jit: Lifted JIT compilation of a module.
safe.flax.linen.make_attention_mask: Builds an attention mask by broadcasting a query/key position comparison.
safe.flax.linen.make_causal_mask: Builds a causal (lower-triangular) attention mask from a shape.
safe.flax.linen.map_variables: Transform mapping over a module's variable collections.
safe.flax.linen.nowrap: Decorator opting a method out of module auto-wrapping; structural.
safe.flax.linen.scan: Lifted scan over a module along an axis.
safe.flax.linen.standardize: Standardizes to zero-mean, unit-variance along an axis.
safe.flax.linen.vmap: Lifted vectorizing map over a module.

unsafe.flax.io.*: File IO shim — reads/writes files on disk (and gs:// cloud storage when available).
unsafe.flax.serialization.*: Serializes model state to bytes / disk.
unsafe.flax.training.checkpoints.*: Writes / reads checkpoints to disk (path accepts gs://).
